q: How does Habakkuk begin his prayer to the LORD?
quote: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear

q: In Habakkuk, by what will the righteous live?
quote: but the righteous will live by faith

q: In Habakkuk, though the crops fail, what will the prophet still do?
why: His joy was in God, not crops.
quote: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!

q: In Habakkuk, what did the LORD tell Habakkuk to do with the vision?
why: So a herald could run with it.
quote: Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets

q: In Habakkuk, the earth will be filled with the knowledge of God's glory as waters cover what?
quote: as the waters cover the sea.

q: In Habakkuk, the Lord makes the prophet's feet like those of what?
quote: He makes my feet like those of a deer

q: In Habakkuk's prayer, which tree does not bud?
quote: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines
